# StockAnalysis Search Stocks

Full-text search for stocks and ETFs by company name or ticker symbol. Returns matches across multiple global exchanges including US, international, and ETF listings.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/stockanalysis/search-stocks" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "apple"}'
```

This API runs asynchronously. The call returns a task `id` with status `pending`; poll `GET https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/run/{id}` until `status` is `completed` and read the result from `outputs[0].data`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | Yes | Search keyword — a company name or ticker symbol (e.g. 'AAPL', 'Microsoft', 'Tesla'). |

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls are not charged.
